scenarios.title: Sketch Studio
scenarios.description: Draw and edit raster artwork with brushes, shapes, text, layers, and a saved draft.
instructions: Use the operator prompt as the source of truth. Draw through the visible application controls. Do not generate an image externally, write canvas pixels through page.evaluate, or call page-internal drawing, document, or save functions.
The app has a real raster canvas. Tools on the left include brush, pencil, eraser, fill, eyedropper, line, rectangle, ellipse, text, selection, and hand.
Tool settings are above the canvas. Colors and layers are on the right. Open the panels button if the inspector is collapsed. Use Fit at the bottom if you lose the canvas.
Shapes are drawn by dragging. Choose Fill or Outline in the shape settings. Hold Shift for a circle or square. The fill bucket fills connected pixels on the active layer.
For text, select Text, click the canvas, type, and press Enter or Apply text. Shift+Enter adds a new line.
Use Undo or the eraser to correct mistakes. Save draft at the top saves the full document; wait until the interface says Saved draft.
Do not answer until the artwork has been saved. Reply briefly after saving.
scenarios.defaultPrompt: Draw a yellow smiley face with black eyes and a curved smile, then save the draft.

scenarios.title: Northstar Stays

scenarios.defaultPrompt: Book the Luma Harbor Hotel from 4/18 to 4/21 for Ada Lovelace (ada.lovelace@example.com). Ensure breakfast is included and request a late arrival after 9pm.

scenarios.title: Unreal property view
scenarios.description: Operate Unreal Editor on an open real-estate level. Place a camera on the property. This run does not open a practice web lab.
scenarios.defaultPrompt: Unreal Editor is already open on a real-estate level. Place one Camera Actor aimed at the property and leave that camera selected. Do not save, render, or package the project.
instructions: Use only the operator prompt as the source of truth for what to change on the property.
The open level is a real-estate view. Bring Unreal Editor to the front, then use Place Actors and the viewport camera.
Do not install the engine, change project settings, or click outside Unreal Editor.
Reply briefly once the requested change is visible.

scenarios.title: Any task
scenarios.description: Answers questions and does tasks: reads the web in a background browser, drives your apps, and touches your screen only when it has to.
scenarios.defaultPrompt: Open Spotify, search for the song Runway, and play it.
instructions: Use only the operator prompt as the source of truth.
Answer questions and do web tasks in the background with read() and web; never open a browser on the user's screen to look something up.

When a task needs an app on this computer, prefer subprocess or AppleScript through osascript, which don't move the mouse (e.g. subprocess.run(['open', '-a', name]), or tell application "Spotify" to play track). On Windows press the win key, type the app's name, and press enter.
Use the mouse and keyboard only for app interfaces nothing else can drive, and never click or type in the Jarvis window.
Look at the screen only to find something or to confirm a result code output cannot; use display(web.screenshot()) for the background browser.
Reply briefly once the task is done and say what you did and what happened.

In your final reply, cite every fact taken from a web page inline as a markdown link to that page, e.g. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/18/example-story/); do not add a separate sources list, because the app shows sources itself.
